Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, a As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 0.5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: Set a = ch.Axes(2): s = "|" & a.MinorUnitIsAuto & "," & a.ScaleType & "," & a.DisplayUnit & "," & a.HasDisplayUnitLabel & "," & a.MajorUnitIsAuto
        s = s & "|" & a.MinorUnitIsAuto & "," & a.ScaleType & "," & a.DisplayUnit & "," & a.HasDisplayUnitLabel & "," & a.MajorUnitIsAuto
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: Set a = ch.Axes(1): s = "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing
        s = s & "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing

        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter: Set a = ch.Axes(1): s = "|" & a.MinorUnitIsAuto & "," & a.ScaleType & "," & a.DisplayUnit & "," & a.HasDisplayUnitLabel & "," & a.MajorUnitIsAuto

        a.MinorUnit = 0.25: a.MinorUnitIsAuto = True

        a.DisplayUnit = xlHundreds: a.DisplayUnit = xlNone
        s = s & "|" & a.MinorUnitIsAuto & "," & a.ScaleType & "," & a.DisplayUnit & "," & a.HasDisplayUnitLabel & "," & a.MajorUnitIsAuto

        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: Set a = ch.Axes(2): s = "|" & a.MinorUnitIsAuto & "," & a.ScaleType & "," & a.DisplayUnit & "," & a.HasDisplayUnitLabel & "," & a.MajorUnitIsAuto

    Case 30

        s = s & "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing
    Case 31
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: Set a = ch.Axes(1): s = "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing
        a.TickMarkSpacing = 32000
        s = s & "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing
    Case 32
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: Set a = ch.Axes(1): s = "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing
        a.TickMarkSpacing = 32001

    Case 33
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: Set a = ch.Axes(1): s = "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing
        a.TickLabelSpacing = 2.5
        s = s & "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing
    Case 34
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: Set a = ch.Axes(1): s = "|" & a.MinorUnitIsAuto & "," & a.ScaleType & "," & a.DisplayUnit & "," & a.HasDisplayUnitLabel & "," & a.MajorUnitIsAuto
        s = s & "|" & a.MinorUnitIsAuto & "," & a.ScaleType & "," & a.DisplayUnit & "," & a.HasDisplayUnitLabel & "," & a.MajorUnitIsAuto
    Case 35

        s = s & "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing
    Case 36
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: Set a = ch.Axes(1): s = "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing
        a.MinorUnit = 1
        s = s & "|" & a.AxisBetweenCategories & "," & a.TickLabelSpacing & "," & a.TickLabelSpacingIsAuto & "," & a.TickMarkSpacing
    End Select
    Tried = "ok" & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 36
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
